title: Capital — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Capital.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Pro-Style Value." Premium tier. Capital Cooking Equipment is made in Southern California — one of the few remaining US-manufactured pro range companies. Their Culinarian and Precision series feature open burners (like BlueStar), self-clean ovens, and commercial-grade construction at prices 20-30% below Wolf and Thermador. Capital also makes outdoor grills.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers who want open-burner cooking performance without the Wolf/BlueStar price tag.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Capital:

• Open burners at 25,000 BTU — restaurant-grade power

• Made in Southern California — genuine US manufacturing

• 20-30% below Wolf/Thermador for comparable cooking performance

• Self-clean oven option — not available on many pro ranges

• Outdoor grills with same commercial-grade build quality
